nodes.name: Manual Run
nodes.notes: Portfolio entry: run once to exercise Scheme B IDs + health probe. Not the doc golden path.

nodes.name: Webhook Entry
nodes.notes: Optional HTTP entry: POST /webhook/obs-kit-facade (or test URL). No credentials required.

nodes.name: Build Scheme B IDs
nodes.notes: Allocates correlation_id + demo trace_id/traceparent. Gate defaults to shadow (L2).

nodes.name: GET Health
nodes.notes: Thin probe only. Override URL via env OBS_FACADE_HEALTH_URL. Default: doc sidecar /health on n8n_platform.

nodes.name: Format Success
nodes.notes: Merge Scheme B IDs with health payload for the canvas / webhook response.

nodes.name: Format Health Error
nodes.notes: Wired error output from GET Health — no dangling error port (Review-5).

nodes.name: Facade Done
nodes.notes: End. Does not call Doc Process / Post — vertical golden path stays in doc-workflow.
